description: Converts a date/time from one time zone to another, correctly handling daylight saving time. If the input already includes an offset or 'Z', from_timezone is ignored.

datetime.description: Date/time in ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-03-08T14:30", "2026-03-08T14:30:00Z", "2026-03-08"), "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm", a Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds, or "now".

from_timezone.description: IANA time zone name, e.g. "America/New_York", "Europe/London", "Asia/Tokyo", or "UTC". Fixed offsets like "UTC+5:30" also work. Defaults to UTC.

to_timezone.description: IANA time zone name, e.g. "America/New_York", "Europe/London", "Asia/Tokyo", or "UTC". Fixed offsets like "UTC+5:30" also work.

name: convert_timezone
title: Convert time zones
